item.title: How to use ngAfterViewInit in Angular
item.description: Accessing child components and DOM elements after the view has been fully initialized is a common requirement in Angular applications. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve implemented countless components that need to interact with child elements after rendering. The most effective approach is using the ngAfterViewInit lifecycle hook, which guarantees that all view children are available and properly initialized. This hook is essential for any operations that depend on the complete view hierarchy being ready.
